method: The listed 70g dry egg noodles is an uncooked weight. Cut the 100g broccoli into small florets. Bring a saucepan of water to the boil, cook the broccoli for 3–4 minutes until just tender, then lift it onto a plate with a slotted spoon. Cook the noodles in the same boiling water for the time on their packet until tender, then drain well. Time this to finish shortly before the pan ingredients are ready.

Deseed and thinly slice the 120g mixed peppers. Cut the 170g chicken breast into thin strips about 1cm thick on a separate board. Wash hands, the board and knife after handling the raw meat; do not rinse it.

Warm a non-stick frying pan over a medium-low heat; this recipe does not include frying oil. Add the chicken breast in one layer and cook for 7–10 minutes, turning regularly. Lower the heat if the outside browns too quickly. Check the centre with a clean food thermometer: it must reach 70°C for 2 minutes. Keep cooking if it has not reached that endpoint; the suggested time is a guide. Transfer to a clean plate; keep the pan for the vegetables. Never reuse the plate or utensils that held the raw food without washing them.

Use the non-stick pan over a medium-low heat; no oil is listed for this recipe. Add 120g mixed peppers and cook for 4–6 minutes, stirring often, until softened with some bite. Cover between stirs for the first 3 minutes so the peppers soften in their own moisture; lower the heat if they catch.
Add the drained noodles and broccoli to the pan. Toss gently for 1–2 minutes to combine without crushing the florets.

Turn the heat to low and fold in the 15ml reduced-salt soy sauce. Stir for 1–2 minutes until hot, following any longer heating instruction on the sauce label. This measured sauce coats the food; do not boil it dry or add an unlisted jar of sauce.

Return the cooked chicken breast and its juices to the pan and stir through. Heat gently until the whole pan is steaming hot, stirring to distribute the heat. Divide the noodles, vegetables and chicken breast between serving bowls. Serve immediately.

review.notes: Cooked thin chicken strips folded through egg noodles, sliced peppers and tender broccoli with light soy coating.
